description: Land Title Settlement Dept - T.R. Orukmankulama, Thirappane D/S/D, Anuradhapura District (25/0379)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively focused on land title registration. It contains formal declarations by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement determining the ownership of specific land parcels (e.g., Parcel 2:1 of Block 3, Parcel 1:2 of Block 4) under the Registration of Title Act. The content details the location, extent, and owner (The State) of the land, which squarely fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters. It does not involve government personnel changes, portfolio assignments, or any of the other specialized non-land categories.
